summary: The agent provides a robust solution featuring comprehensive time-series feature engineering, proper temporal data splitting, and effective mitigation of outliers via target clipping. However, a moderate data leakage issue occurs when computing global average item prices across the entire training dataframe (which includes the validation month). Additionally, the stochastic LightGBM model is evaluated only once on a single metric.
